name: Zagra (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and green with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Zagra (a castle on red and a tree).
history: Zagra adopted its arms and flag officially on 19 December 1992; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three horizontal stripes, yellow, white and green, the white twice as wide as the others, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Zagra arms — castle on red and tree
